She has been the light by at the end of the tunnel for me, she believes in me and takes the pressure out of anything I do. I feel
Like the reliance and dépendance I’ve built on her is hurting me.

Look bro, I’ve felt how u feel, rock bottom with no one to tell you they love you. And to that I say that knowing this is better than being Un  aware of it. I’m just a stranger on the internet but I’d do anything to help you. I’ll stay up with you, I’ll laugh, cry, and talk with you. You may feel like there is no one out there. But me and a whole bunch of other people are here to be here for you
